question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund is evaluating Alpha Ltd: PAT = INR 100 lakh, paid-up capital = INR 200 lakh split into 20 lakh shares of INR 10 each, trading P/E of 32. What is the implied market price per share?

explanation.text: The Logic: EPS = 1,00,00,000 / 20,00,000 = INR 5. CMP = P/E * EPS = 32 * 5 = INR 160. Directly from Example 12.7. The Trap: INR 32 is just the P/E. INR 320 doubles EPS incorrectly. INR 50 uses paid-up capital ratio. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XXI-B, XV all test P/E-implied price. XIX-B tests this for relative valuation of Cat III NAV pitch.
